views.name: city_avg_population_by_state
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.state_name AS state_name,
  COUNT(c.city_name) AS city_count,
  AVG(c.population) AS average_city_population,
  SUM(c.population) AS total_city_population
FROM city AS c
JOIN state AS s ON c.state_name = s.state_name
WHERE c.population IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.state_name
views.description: Per-state aggregate of city counts and average city population. Exposes measures to answer ranking questions (which state has highest average city population) while remaining reusable for other aggregations or filters.

views.name: city_population_rank_within_state_27
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.city_name AS city_name,
  c.state_name AS state_name,
  c.population AS population,
  (

    FROM city AS c2

FROM city AS c

views.name: lake_area_by_country
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  lake.country_name AS country_name,

  lake.lake_name AS lake_name
FROM lake
GROUP BY lake.country_name
HAVING COUNT(lake.lake_name) > 0
views.description: Per-country aggregated measures for lakes: count of lakes and average lake area. Keeps one row per country that has at least one lake (uses lake_base_rows as input).

views.name: state_computed_density
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.state_name AS state_name,
  s.population AS population,
  s.area AS area,
  s.density AS stored_density,
  (CAST(s.population AS REAL) / s.area) AS computed_density
FROM state_core s
WHERE s.population IS NOT NULL
  AND s.area > 0
views.description: Per-state computed density measure (population divided by area). Keeps one row per state with both stored density (if present) and fully computed density for validation/comparison and ranking.

views.name: state_density_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.state_name AS state_name,
  s.population AS population,
  s.area AS area,
  CASE
    WHEN s.area > 0 AND s.population IS NOT NULL THEN (CAST(s.population AS REAL) / s.area)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS computed_density,
  s.density AS stored_density,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.area > 0 AND s.population IS NOT NULL THEN (CAST(s.population AS REAL) / s.area) ELSE NULL END DESC) AS density_rank,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.area > 0 AND s.population IS NOT NULL THEN (CAST(s.population AS REAL) / s.area) ELSE NULL END DESC) AS density_dense_rank
FROM state AS s
WHERE s.population IS NOT NULL
  AND s.area > 0
views.description: Per-state density ranking using computed density; provides rank/dense_rank and retains stored density for easy tie handling and validation. Useful for top-k or tie-aware queries.

views.name: state_summary
views.body_sql:
